```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import os

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# INITIALIZATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

# Simulation parameters
step_size = 2e-3
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # 50 FPS

# Vehicle initial parameters
initLoc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.0)
initYaw = chrono.CH_C_PI / 12  # 15 degrees
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
tire_type = veh.TireModelType.TMEASY

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE THE VEHICLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
vehicle = veh.FEDA(False, veh.ChContactMethod(contact_method))
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(initLoc, chrono.Q_from_AngZ(initYaw)))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_type)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(step_size)
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.MESH)
vehicle.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE THE TERRAIN
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(
    chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.ChVectorD(200, 200, 2),  # size
    0.0,  # height
)
# Set custom texture
patch.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("path/to/your/texture.jpg"), 200, 200)
terrain.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IRRLICHT VISUALIZATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
app = veh.ChWheeledVehicleIrrApp(vehicle, 'FEDA Demo', irr.dimension2du(1024, 768))
app.SetSkyBox()
app.AddTypicalLights()
app.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVectorF(30, 100, 100), chrono.ChVectorF(0, 0, 0), 250, 1, 10, 60)
app.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75), 6.0, 0.5)  # (track point, distance, height)
app.SetTimestep(step_size)
app.AssetBindAll()
app.AssetUpdateAll()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DRIVER SYSTEM (interactive)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(app)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.04)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.1)
driver.Initialize()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SIMULATION LOOP
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
render_steps = int(render_step_size / step_size)
step_number = 0

while app.GetDevice().run():
    # Render scene
    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        app.BeginScene()
        app.DrawAll()
        app.EndScene()

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules
    driver.Synchronize(app.GetSimulationTime())
    terrain.Synchronize(app.GetSimulationTime())
    vehicle.Synchronize(app.GetSimulationTime(), driver_inputs, terrain)
    app.Synchronize("FEDA Demo", driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    app.Advance(step_size)

    # Maintain real-time pace
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
    step_number += 1
```

**NOTES:**

- The camera follows the vehicle from behind and above.
- The interactive driver uses keyboard controls (arrows/WASD for steering/throttle/brake).
- All vehicle parts use mesh visualization.
- The simulation runs at 50 FPS.

```python
# Visualization type for vehicle parts
vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Collision type for chassis
chassis_collision_type = veh.CollisionType_NONE

# Type of tire model
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY

# 3. Terrain Length Change
terrainHeight = 0
terrainLength = 200.0  # Changed from 100.0 to 200.0
terrainWidth = 100.0

# Camera tracking point
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-3.0, 0.0, 1.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the FEDA vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
vehicle = veh.FEDA()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('FEDA vehicle')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# 1. Driver System Modification: Path-follower, cruise-control driver

# Create ISO double lane change path
# ISO 3888-2:2011 standard: lane width 3.5m, entry/exit 12m, first offset 11m, second offset 12m, etc.
# We'll use a simplified version for demonstration.

path_points = chrono.vector_ChVector3d()

# Start straight
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(-50, 0, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(-40, 0, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(-30, 0, 0.5))

# First lane change (to +3.5m)
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(-20, 3.5, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, 3.5, 0.5))

# Back to center
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 0, 0.5))

# Second lane change (to -3.5m)
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(20, -3.5, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(30, -3.5, 0.5))

# Back to center and finish
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(40, 0, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(50, 0, 0.5))
path_points.push_back(chrono.ChVector3d(60, 0, 0.5))

# Create the path as a Bezier curve
path = chrono.ChBezierCurve(path_points)
path_name = "ISO_DoubleLaneChange"
path_obj = veh.ChPath(path, path_name, True)  # closed=False

# Visualize the path
path_color = chrono.ChColor(0.0, 0.8, 0.0)
vis.GetSceneManager().addPath(path_obj, path_color, 1.0, False)

# Create the path-follower driver
target_speed = 10.0  # m/s

# Steering controller parameters
look_ahead_distance = 5.0
steering_gain = 0.8    # Proportional gain
steering_integral = 0  # Integral gain
steering_derivative = 0 # Derivative gain

# Speed controller parameters
speed_gain = 0.4       # Proportional gain
speed_integral = 0     # Integral gain
speed_derivative = 0   # Derivative gain

driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(
    vehicle.GetVehicle(),
    path_obj,
    "ISO_DoubleLaneChange",
    target_speed,
    look_ahead_distance,
    steering_gain,
    steering_integral,
    steering_derivative,
    speed_gain,
    speed_integral,
    speed_derivative
)

driver.Initialize()

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counters
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
